editorial:
Imagine the bright colors and high energy of the eighties fitness craze. You get all of that here as you follow a hardworking aerobics teacher who is totally dedicated to her gym. Then you have a cynical reporter who shows up to write a story about health clubs. At first, they really do not get along. He thinks the whole fitness world is a joke, and she thinks he is just another rude guy. It is a fun setup that feels like a classic romantic clash where two people from different worlds are forced to spend time together.

You will love the chemistry between the leads and the nostalgic look of the old-school workout gear. While the plot is simple, the acting makes it feel real and sweet. Some parts move a bit slow, but the charm makes up for it. If you want a lighthearted trip back to 1985, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in high definition and is perfect for a cozy night in.
endingExplained: After a lot of arguing and misunderstandings, the two main characters finally realize they actually care for each other. The reporter stops being so judgmental about the fitness world, and the instructor opens up her heart. They decide to put their differences aside and commit to a real relationship. The movie wraps up on a happy note, showing that love can happen even when you start off as enemies.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro rom-coms and eighties fashion.
